name: residual strain
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
usage_overview: 残余应变用于描述材料卸载后保留的不可恢复变形，并在循环荷载分析中反映变形累积及永久变形的形成。在混凝土轨道损伤模型中，其变化还与加载路径及拉压转换有关。

complete_examples.text: Due to the dynamic effects of the cyclic moving vehicle on the tracks, the fatigue damage and residual strain of filling layer, which is controlled by fatigue damage constitutive relation of mortar materials, are accumulated.

As shown in Fig. 18 , the strain and corresponding residual strain evolution of a measurement point subject to a passing vehicle can be obtained against the first and the last cyclic moving vehicle increment.
As shown in Fig. 24, the residual strain is fluctuated by the time-varying normal strain.
However, it should also be noticed that the residual strain exists reduction condition.
